text:
Type: striped low pile area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, softening floors; living room, bedroom, study
Style: contemporary, modern, mid-century modern
Materials: dense low pile with a soft wool-look texture
Colors: slate blue-grey, warm brown, light grey, black, thin cream lines
Shape: rectangular, horizontal bands of varied widths in tonal stripes, clean straight edges, flat and low, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, refined, grounded, calm
Goes with: grey or brown sofas, walnut or dark wood, blue accents; modern or mid-century modern living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
